subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: Orientation / Perceptual development
source.subtopic: Showing respect, love, empathy and acceptance

show.line: We show respect. We are kind, we listen and we care about others.

rounds.prompt: A new child is alone. What do you do?
You want a pencil. What magic word do you say?
accept: please may i have a pencil

rounds.story: Musa speaks a different language. Tom smiles and shows him the toilets. How is Tom?
rounds.praise: Kind! Tom made Musa feel welcome.

rounds.prompt: Your friend is sad. How do you show you care?
Greet your teacher. Say good morning!

hints: Treat others how you want to be treated.
Kind words and listening show respect.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I want a crayon.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I should say please.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: May I please have the crayon? Thank you!

parent_line: Shows respect, kindness and acceptance to others.
